title: The Role of Monitoring Effect in Risk Classification: Evidence from Telematics Adoption
authors: Ho Cheung Brian Lee; Xinxin Li; Siyuan Liu
eligible_reason: Single adoption date. Field experiment with a treatment group of drivers whose telematics device is activated on 1 June 2018 and deactivated on 1 September 2018 for everyone (final_run.do lines 211-228: period2_date = 01jun2018, period3_date = 01sep2018 for all drivers). Table 3: reghdfe harsh c.treat#c.(activation_stage deactivation_stage), absorb(id date) vce(cluster id). Two-group pre/post design with common dates; fails the at-least-two-adoption-dates rule. Treatment also switches off for all units simultaneously.
design_notes: Driver-day panel (driver_data.dta -> data.dta), March-December 2018, stages: pre-activation (Mar-May), activation (Jun-Aug), post-activation (Sep-Dec). Treat = randomized treatment group. Tables 3-4: TWFE-style regressions with driver and date FE, treat x stage indicators and treat x stage x preharsh interactions (Table 4), stage-day trends. Tables 5-6: misclassification analysis and cross-sectional regressions; Appendix: ppmlhdfe, normalized outcomes, driver-level regressions.
estimators_reported: two-way FE regression with treat x stage interactions (reghdfe, id and date FE)
data_files: driver_data.dta not shipped (NDA with insurer); stat.xlsx summary statistics; log_main_file.smcl, log_appendix_A/B_file.smcl
screener_notes: Screened from package only (README.pdf, final_run.do, logs).
